newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch post Dfl 3.6 billion January trade surplus.
newsitem.headline: Dutch post Dfl 3.6 billion January trade surplus.

text.p: The Dutch trade surplus was a provisional 3.6 billion guilders in January 1997, unchanged from December, the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) said.

The CBS said that it had introduced a slightly new calculation system and for this reason it had revised the January 1996 trade surplus figure to 2.2 billion guilders to make it comparable to the January 1997 figure.
NOTE - Merchandise trade in billions of guilders.
The CBS said the January 1997 trade surplus was rounded down to 3.6 billion guilders but the full figure was close to 3.64 billion guilders.
The CBS said it had not yet revised the December 1996 figure to the new calcalation system, but the original December 1996 figure was 3.6 billion guilders.
The CBS said the new system was giving an even more precise outcome.
The revised December figure will follow later.
Because of the change, the CBS said it would be better to compare the January 1997 figure with January 1996.
